name: nadabodha
description: Local audio transcription macOS desktop app (Electron + Python)
author: Nadabodha

scripts.compile: mkdir -p assets/bin && clang -framework ApplicationServices -O2 native/mac-paste.c -o assets/bin/mac-paste && tsc && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.build: npm run compile && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir && rm -f release/mac-arm64/Nadabodha.app/Nadabodha.app && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/mac-arm64/Nadabodha.app && rm -f Nadabodha.app && ln -s release/mac-arm64/Nadabodha.app Nadabodha.app

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nadabodha needs microphone access to record audio and dictate text.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Nadabodha needs permission to control System Events to automatically paste dictated text at your cursor.
